column3: NKJV moves “were gathered together at Jerusalem” to the end of verse 6; the Greek has “gathered … in Jerusalem” in verse 5.
NKJV ends this verse with “were gathered together at Jerusalem,” words the Greek places in verse 5.
NKJV includes “of Israel,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “elders.”
NKJV has “severely threaten,” following the Textus Receptus, which doubles the word “threaten”; the critical text has “let us warn them.”
NKJV includes “You are God,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “Master, You who made heaven.”
NKJV has “by the mouth of Your servant David,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “through the Holy Spirit, by the mouth of our father David Your servant.”
NKJV lacks “in this city,” as does the Textus Receptus; the critical text includes it.
